title: AI Tools
symptomCheckerDesc: Enter your symptoms to get possible diagnoses
disclaimer: This tool is for informational purposes only. Always consult a healthcare professional.
pneumoniaSubtitle: Upload a chest X-ray image for AI-assisted pneumonia screening
pneumoniaDisclaimer: AI-assisted screening only. Not a final diagnosis. Final clinical decision must be made by a qualified physician.
pneumoniaFileHelp: Supported: JPG, PNG. Max size: 10 MB.
pneumoniaEmpty: Upload an X-ray image to start analysis
pneumoniaFileTooLarge: File is too large. Maximum 10 MB.
pneumoniaInvalidType: Invalid file type. Use JPG or PNG.
positiveExplanation: Pneumonia pattern detected above the clinical threshold.
negativeExplanation: No pneumonia pattern exceeded the clinical threshold.
probabilityBelowThreshold: {{prob}}% is below the {{threshold}}% threshold, so the AI screening classification is Negative.
probabilityAboveThreshold: {{prob}}% exceeds the {{threshold}}% threshold, indicating a positive screening result.
recommendationPositive: Review chest X-ray with clinical symptoms. Radiologist or physician evaluation is recommended.
recommendationNegative: If symptoms persist, clinical evaluation is still recommended regardless of screening result.
recommendationElevated: Probability is elevated but below the positive threshold. Consider clinical review given the moderate-to-high probability.
gradcamInterpretationWarning: Grad-CAM is an interpretability aid showing regions that influenced the model. It does not prove disease location. Red/yellow = higher influence. Blue = lower influence.
confidenceNote: Confidence is a model score reflecting distance from the decision boundary. It is not clinical certainty.
finalClinicalDisclaimer: This AI result is for screening support only. It is not a final diagnosis. Final clinical decisions must be made by qualified healthcare professionals.
cds_interp_low: The AI model found low similarity to pneumonia-positive training patterns. Low probability suggests the image does not closely match known pneumonia presentations.
cds_interp_moderate: The probability is not negligible but remains below the positive threshold. Clinical context including symptoms, exam findings, and patient history is important for interpretation.
cds_interp_elevated: The probability is elevated but did not exceed the configured screening threshold. Consider physician review, especially if respiratory symptoms, fever, or abnormal auscultation are present.
cds_interp_high: The model detected pneumonia-like visual patterns above the clinical screening threshold. This suggests findings consistent with pneumonia. Physician and radiologist review is recommended.
cds_findingsPositive: Pneumonia-like opacification patterns detected above the AI screening threshold.
cds_findingsNegative: No pneumonia pattern exceeded the AI screening threshold on this image.
cds_significancePositive: Recommend correlation with clinical symptoms and physician/radiologist review.
cds_significanceNegative: If clinical symptoms persist, further medical evaluation is still required regardless of screening result.
cds_rec_low: Routine clinical correlation. If symptoms persist, clinical evaluation is still recommended.
cds_rec_moderate: Clinical correlation recommended. Consider additional review if symptoms, fever, or abnormal exam findings are present.
cds_rec_elevated: Probability is elevated but below the positive threshold. Physician or radiologist review is recommended before excluding pneumonia.
cds_rec_high: Urgent clinical review recommended. Correlate with symptoms, oxygen saturation, laboratory findings, and radiologist interpretation.
cds_benchmarkNote: This image was analyzed by the live DenseNet121 model. EfficientNet-B0 is shown as benchmark evidence from prior validation, not live inference.
cds_benchmarkConclusion: DenseNet121 is the selected default model because it has higher recall (fewer missed pneumonia cases), best F1, and best AUC across all three models.
searchPatient: Search patients by name or ID...
saveToRecordDesc: Save this analysis result to {{patient}}'s medical record for physician review.
saveSuccessDesc: The analysis has been saved to the patient record and is pending physician review.
selectPatientToSave: Select a patient above to save this analysis to their medical record.
analysesSubtitle: View and review all AI-assisted pneumonia screening results
reviewDialogDesc: Set the review status and optionally add a clinical comment.
doctorCommentPlaceholder: Add your clinical assessment or notes...
rejectRequiresComment: A clinical comment is required when rejecting an analysis.
ensembleModeDesc: Runs DenseNet121, EfficientNet-B0, and ResNet50 with weighted average consensus. More robust but slower.
singleModelModeDesc: Runs the default DenseNet121 model only. Fastest option.
ensembleRunning: Running three AI models... This may take longer than single-model analysis.
noEnsembleImages: No explainability images available for this analysis.
report_findings_low: The AI screening did not detect clear radiological indicators supporting pneumonia in this image.
report_findings_moderate: The AI screening detected inconclusive radiological indicators that may require clinical correlation.
report_findings_elevated: The AI screening detected possible radiological indicators that may be associated with a pneumonia pattern.
report_findings_high: The AI screening detected relatively strong radiological indicators that may be consistent with pneumonia.
report_impression_low: The AI-assisted analysis suggests a low probability of pneumonia.
report_impression_moderate: The AI-assisted analysis suggests a moderate probability of pneumonia. Clinical evaluation is needed.
report_impression_elevated: The AI-assisted analysis suggests an elevated probability of pneumonia, though the result did not exceed the positive classification threshold.
report_impression_high: The AI-assisted analysis classifies this result as high suspicion for pneumonia.
report_significance_low: The result is relatively reassuring, but does not fully exclude disease if clinical symptoms are strong.
report_significance_moderate: This result should be interpreted alongside symptoms, clinical examination, and inflammatory markers.
report_significance_elevated: This result may be clinically significant in the presence of respiratory symptoms such as fever, cough, dyspnea, or decreased oxygen saturation.
report_significance_high: This result may require more urgent medical attention depending on the patient's condition and overall clinical picture.
report_rec_low: Clinical follow-up is recommended based on the patient's condition. The AI result alone should not be relied upon.
report_rec_moderate: Physician review and clinical correlation are recommended. Additional tests may be needed depending on the case.
report_rec_elevated: Specialist physician review is recommended. Correlate with symptoms and laboratory findings before making a final decision.
report_rec_high: Clinical evaluation by a specialist physician is recommended. Correlate with the patient's clinical picture and accompanying investigations.
report_agreement_strong: There is strong agreement between all three models on the direction of the result.
report_agreement_moderate: There is moderate agreement between the models. The result should be interpreted with caution and correlated clinically.
report_agreement_low: There is low agreement between the models. A thorough medical review is warranted before relying on this result.
report_agreement_single: This result was produced by a single model. Model agreement measurement is not available.
report_gradcam_ensemble_note: The Grad-CAM heatmap is generated from the default DenseNet121 model and does not represent a separate explanation for each model in the ensemble analysis.
report_disclaimer: This result is AI-assisted clinical support and is not a final diagnosis. The final decision must be made by a qualified physician.
analytics_subtitle: Monitor AI usage, model behavior, and physician-reviewed performance.
analytics_noData: No analytics data available for the selected period.
analytics_insufficientData: Insufficient reviewed data to calculate performance metrics.
analytics_clinicalPerfNote: These metrics are estimates based only on physician-reviewed records and do not represent a final clinical evaluation of the model.
analytics_disclaimer: These analytics are for usage monitoring and quality support. They do not represent a final clinical evaluation of the AI models.
analytics_noFilteredData: No analytics data matching the selected filters.
